The proposed freeway connection will also provide the opportunity for modified transit service over it as an alternative to continued automobile use.
Accommodating the expected travel demands to General Mitchell Field with construction of the Airport Spur Freeway will result in a higher level of traffic service, greater accessibility, safer traffic operations, reduced travel times, reduced vehicle pollutants and less noise.
Co-operative planning which recognizes the mutual dependence on orderly growth of General Mitchell Field to the total transportation system of the State of Wisconsin can only result in lending to the longterm productivity of the area.
